rundown: 76ers beat Pacers 131-124 at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PA in front of 21,024. 76ers led 58-57 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: 76ers won it 39-30.
Leading the way — Pacers: Pascal Siakam 31 pts; Quenton Jackson 8 ast, 6 reb. 76ers: Jaylen Brown 31 pts; LeBron James 11 ast; Dean Wade 7 reb.
Where 76ers won it: they shot 55% to 53% and shot 43% from three to 25%.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): 76ers closed as 7.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Pacers +7.5 cashed); the total closed at 226.5 and they combined for 255, over by 28.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 15, 12:55 PM ET. It had Pacers 31% and 76ers 69%, projecting Pacers 108.4 – 76ers 114.1 (222.6 total, 76ers by 5.7).

Final: Pacers 124 – 76ers 131. Right winner: it had 76ers at 69%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Pacers came in with a 2% below average attack and a league-average defense (5-8, 111.2 scored and 113.2 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 74 and 75 games of evidence. Projected to score 108.4, they scored 124 (+15.6 points, 14% over); projected to allow 114.1, they allowed 131 (+16.9 points, 15% over).

76ers came in with a league-average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (10-3, 111.2 scored and 109.4 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 74 and 75 games of evidence. Projected to score 114.1, they scored 131 (+16.9 points, 15% over); projected to allow 108.4, they allowed 124 (+15.6 points, 14% over).

The bigger miss was 76ers' scoring (+16.9 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 255 against 222.6 projected (+32.4), about the 96th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: 76ers by 7 against 76ers by 5.7 projected, about the 54th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
PHI ML (-288) at -288: the algo gave it 71% vs 71% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 71%). IND ML (+235) at +235: the algo gave it 29% vs 29% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 29%). PHI -7.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. IND +7.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.6 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 226.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-0.8 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. UNDER 226.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 26% of bets on Pacers, 21% of the money — Pacers covered; total: 80% of bets on the over, 83% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 6% of bets on Pacers, 4% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was 76ers, who won and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.138 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +2 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 82 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.995 and gives home teams +0.7 points. Team corrections so far: Pacers attack ×1.005, defense ×0.988 (6 games); 76ers attack ×1.006, defense ×1.018 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
